text:
jamie: Quick preflight — proposing to enable sable-13b-quantv2 in EU tonight during the 22:00-23:30 UTC change window. Staged canary: 1% -> 10% -> 30%. Need agreement on fallback ordering and rollback triggers.
rachel: +1 for the window. confirm that EU capacity has the new kernels deployed?
marc: kernel patch landed on eu-gpu pool earlier today, yes. perf smoke looked fine.
leo: fallback ordering suggestion: quantv2 -> quantv1 (legacy quant) -> fp16. quantv1 preserves quant semantics; fp16 last for stability.
jamie: agree with that fallback ladder. Also want to pin the current production model id (sable-13b@rev-20240201) as the emergency rollback target.
sre_sarah: I can own realtime monitoring for the first 45m. I'll watch 99p latency, p50/p95, and error-rate. What's the thresholds?
marc: propose thresholds: 99p latency > 1200ms (absolute), error rate increase > 0.5% absolute vs baseline, or eval drift: automated golden-set BLEU/QA drop > 3% -> immediate rollback.
rachel: add token generation skew: if average tokens/sec drops by > 25% for > 5m, that's also a rollback signal.
jamie: good. Release notes link for customer-facing copy: https://redwood-internal/notes/sable-quantv2-2026-03-21 (check before cut).
deploybot: scheduling canary: runbook attached. Command to start canary: ```deploybot start-canary --model sable-13b-quantv2 --region eu --steps 1%,10%,30% --fallback "sable-13b-quantv1,sable-13b-fp16" --rollback-target sable-13b@rev-20240201```
opsbot: quota checks passed for eu-gpu pool. Burst buffer headroom 18%.
leo: small ops ask — pin circuit to prevent autoscaler from evicting canary slots for first 60m so metrics stabilize.
jamie: done, pin applied: pin-id pin-20260321-eu-sable.
deploybot: canary started at 22:00 UTC, step 1% rolled. Observability links: http://obs.redwood/canary/6498765432
sre_sarah: watching — p50/p95 look okay at 1%. moving to 10% at +12m unless any alerts.
deploybot: progressed to 10% at 22:18 UTC.
sre_sarah: 22:23 — seeing a small 99p blip to 1350ms for 3m, error rate +0.2%. holding at 10% and investigating.
marc: rolling diagnostics: redis connection latencies increased on eu-edge-03 around the time window. not seeing model CPU issues yet.
leo: can we isolate by redirecting traffic away from eu-edge-03?
deploybot: routing change applied: removed eu-edge-03 from canary pool.
jamie: after routing change, 99p back down to 960ms. recommendation: proceed to 30% after 10 more minutes of stable metrics.
sre_sarah: agree. continuing watch.
deploybot: progressed to 30% at 22:41 UTC.
opsbot: note for postmortem: eu-edge-03 had transient redis replica lag; will file infra ticket.
jamie: final check — anyone want the rollout paused for longer?
marc: no, looks stable. ship it. make sure release notes updated with the fallback list and rollback target.
deploybot: canary complete. model enabled at 30% for EU; final config pinned. To rollback manually: ```deploybot rollback --to sable-13b@rev-20240201 --region eu```
jamie: thanks all — closing handoff to product for customer comms. :tada:
